name: New Mexico
overview: A statewide refundable senior property-tax rebate covers owners and renters. A separate county-option rebate covers qualifying owners in participating counties.

programs.name: Property Tax Rebate for Persons 65 or Older
programs.incomeDefinition: Modified gross income of taxpayer, spouse and dependents, including nontaxable income and excluding specified sources; losses do not offset income.
programs.formulaSummary: Qualifying property tax billed plus 6% of rent, less the maximum tax liability in Table 2; apply the cap.
programs.application: PIT-RC Section 3 with PIT-1, including when filing only for refundable relief.
eligibilityNotes: At least six months’ physical presence and qualifying New Mexico residency.
Dependency, institutional residence and tax-exempt housing restrictions apply.
programs.programYear: 2025 property tax billed/rent paid; income-tax return filed in 2026.

programs.name: Additional Low Income Property Tax Rebate
programs.formulaSummary: Multiply qualifying billed property tax by the Table 3 income-tier percentage; apply cap.
programs.application: PIT-RC Section 4 with PIT-1; identify the qualifying county.
eligibilityNotes: The 2025 form lists Los Alamos, Santa Fe, Doña Ana and Bernalillo counties.
interactions: Separate from the statewide senior rebate; apply PIT-RC coordination rules.
programs.programYear: 2025 tax year; county adoption is required.

researchNotes: The agency’s general county-rebate webpage lists only three counties, but the actual 2025 PIT-RC explicitly includes Bernalillo; the annual form governs this inventory.
Do not confuse the general low-income comprehensive rebate with property-tax-specific relief.
